description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 66 A(1) Filling of a Vacancy in the office of members of the Walikaman West Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes - the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by resignation, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
